tiles.name: Completed

tiles.name: Shipped

tiles.name: Pending
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM orders WHERE status = 'Pending'

tiles.name: Total Revenue
tiles.query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total), 2) as revenue FROM orders

dashboard_items.title: Order Details
dashboard_items.query: SELECT o.order_id, c.name as customer, o.order_date, o.status, o.total FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = '${tile_name}' ORDER BY o.order_date DESC

dashboard_items.title: All Orders
dashboard_items.query: SELECT o.order_id, c.name as customer, o.order_date, o.status, o.total FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date DESC

dashboard_items.title: Product Inventory
dashboard_items.query: SELECT product_name, category, price, stock_level FROM products ORDER BY category, product_name
